name: Margot Naito
source: A blonde, six-winged Black Mage, as well as Malga Naruze’s lover. Always smiling. Freely uses her abilities in flight, characteristic of her race. Pursues a career in the transportation industry. Naito holds a business license allowing Naruze and herself to work as couriers, otherwise known as "Flying Witches". Due to an angel's natural abilities their involvement in this industry is a source of amusement for the residents of Musashi.
